# [Predefined Models of Quantum States](@id Predefined-Models-of-Quantum-States)


The submodule `QuantumSavory.StatesZoo` provides models for many frequently used quantum states.

For each public state model, documented constructor parameters and their
expected-value introspection form the supported construction surface. Concrete
struct fields and storage layout are internal, even when a constructor parameter
currently has the same name.
